results: All 1–7 day options, four EV slots and both goals preserve original deadline time, target, guarantee and kWh progress
Without an active plan, completed plan, invalid option or impossible DST time there is no new goal or mutation
Extension uses the saved deadline rather than today; repeated actions add to the current deadline
Every legacy, generic and configured SoC/kWh input is blocked while an extended plan is active
Existing widget multi-day plans also block competing Flow inputs while keeping their own editor available
Restart, midnight, expired deadline, disconnect/reconnect and pauses preserve fixed deadlines and remaining energy
Goal completion releases input protection and survives restart without rearming the completed goal
Existing Clear EV Plan cancels only selected EV and remains clear through restart
Local calendar extension preserves clock time across 23-hour and 25-hour DST days
Existing override modes remain available and legacy single-day Flow targets retain replacement semantics
Flow extensions retain configured and session mode ownership, including Emergency, without deferred or stale mode restoration
Completed extended goals remain stopped across restart but cannot block a later explicit Emergency override
Full decision reasons match widget selection in both languages, including all fallback branches and long explanations
WAF uses exact existing widget gradient and publishes red/orange/green plus empty unavailable state
Every extra tag is global, changed-only, clears when irrelevant and uses the same reason as the status API without new timers
Active card options are additive; all deprecated card manifests and existing arguments remain byte-for-byte compatible
